As Arista Networks INC (ANET) Stock Declined, De Burlo Group INC Cut Stake by $4.55 Million
 Michael Collier
De Burlo Group Inc decreased its stake in Arista Networks Inc (ANET) by 32.74% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. De Burlo Group Inc sold 17,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.73% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 36,370 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $9.36 million, down from 54,070 at the end of the previous reported quarter. De Burlo Group Inc who had been investing in Arista Networks Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.88B market cap company. The stock increased 2.30% or $5.37 during the last trading session, reaching $238.95. About 1.18 million shares traded or 4.26% up from the average. Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE:ANET) has risen 54.10% uptrending. It has outperformed by 38.48% the S&P500.
De Burlo Group Inc, which manages about $619.44M and $472.39 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Qualys Inc (NASDAQ:QLYS) by 45,900 shares to 146,200 shares, valued at $12.32 million in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Proofpoint Inc (NASDAQ:PFPT) by 68,700 shares in the quarter, for a total of 84,700 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE:ANET) to report earnings on November, 1. They expect $1.61 earnings per share, up 17.52 % or $0.24 from last year’s $1.37 per share. ANET’s profit will be $120.47 million for 37.10 P/E if the $1.61 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.65 actual earnings per share reported by Arista Networks, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.42 % negative EPS growth.
